dedupe_keys.name: bacnet wireshark capture files kargs net

description: kargs.net hosts a public directory of Wireshark capture files of BACnet, the building automation and control networking protocol, together with a PDF guide on analysing BACnet with Wireshark. The files cover BACnet over IP, Ethernet, ARCNET and MS/TP, BBMD and foreign device registration, read and write property services, atomic file transfers, change of value subscriptions, event notifications, schedules, device discovery, segmentation and malformed or edge-case packets, including captures from vendor plugfests and interoperability tests. Coverage: protocol traffic from test benches and field systems, without a stated building or country scope. Access: direct download of individual capture files from the directory. Licence: none stated; free to download. Caveats: the files are protocol examples for developers, not a labelled security dataset, and they carry no metadata on the buildings or dates. Simulation uses are testing BACnet parsers and intrusion detection rules, and building realistic traffic for building automation cyber security testbeds. Related records: the Brick schema and Project Haystack records on building automation semantics.
